about_short_description.short_description: DepositBook is an online platform and an open banking network which connects Banks and Depositors globally.

product.name: Global Wholesale Deposit Marketplace
product.description: An online platform connecting banks and depositors worldwide for high-value deposits.

product.name: Central Account for Depositors
product.description: Provides a unified account for depositors to manage and transact with global banks.

identifier.value: White Label Platform for Third-Party Deposits

product.name: White Label Platform for Third-Party Deposits
product.description: Enables banks to offer third-party deposit products to their customers under their own brand.

product.name: High Value Deposit Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace offering access to special deposit rates from global banks.

product.name: Direct Client Onboarding
product.description: Facilitates the onboarding of clients with a nominated custodian bank for deposit transactions.

identifier.value: Access to Institutional and Corporate Deposits

product.name: Access to Institutional and Corporate Deposits
product.description: Allows banks to access deposits from corporates, financial institutions, and family offices globally.
